notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 修复大量重复待办导致启动加载失败、反复重试无效的问题；日程分页完整读取，优化完成状态关联查询。包含小纸条回复缓存、手绘信纸及经期权限提示优化。
notes.en: Fixes startup failures and ineffective retries with large recurring todo schedules. Loads all occurrences with pagination and improves completion queries. Includes cached replies, note stationery, and period permission guidance.
